note: Independent re-judgment on 2026-11-25 against RFC 1195 Section 4.4 ('IP-capable IS-IS routers therefore must be able to forward IP packets over existing adjacencies to routers with which they share physical connectivity, even when the IP address of the adjacent interface of the neighboring router is on a different logical IP subnet.'). In TestFIBOnLinkAdjacencyAndUnsupportedPrefix, commit 1f82b2727d only renamed iface.LoadBackend("netlink") to iface.LoadBackend("kernel") (the same newNetlinkBackend in internal/plugins/iface/netlink) and reworded two comments; every setup step and kernel RouteGet assertion is unchanged. Positive: off-subnet gateway 192.0.2.2 on the 172.31.254.0/24 link is installed through Loc-RIB, sysrib JSON events, and the real FIB writer with RTNH_F_ONLINK (single and multipath), alongside unchanged TestRFC1195OffSubnetNeighborIsOnLinkNextHop. Negative: clearing only OnLink flips kernel forwarding to the covering route's gateway 172.31.254.2 with RTNH_F_ONLINK clear (and sibling promotion retains RTNH_F_ONLINK), alongside unchanged TestRFC1195OffSubnetNeighborNotResolvedBySubnet.
